column1: # Permanent record of human judgements on individual questions.
# "repair" is a THIRD verdict no builder applies: it marks a report that asks
# for a fix rather than a deletion (a US question the pack failed to mark, or a
# level that is wrong). A person acts on those; emitting them as "bad" would
# delete a good question for a one-byte defect.
# ids are content hashes of the clue. They survive a REBUILD and they do NOT
# survive an edit to the clue itself -- board #146, where an in-place repair
# moved 349 ids and orphaned 76 ratings silently. collect_flags.py --manifest
# takes the id frozen at build time, which is the only form that holds.
# Appended to by hand, and by collect_flags.py reading a card's pack.state.
